daily.topThemeTitle: Students Write Their Own National AI Policy
daily.topThemeBody: EdSurge and AASA report over 130 student leaders from all 50 states approved the STUDENTS FIRST Act, a student-authored AI policy framework covering privacy, authentic learning, and human judgment, at Boston's America's Youth AI Festival.
